$comment: Set list with release dates (UTC, global release) and card counts. Release-time convention: global releases go live at 18:00 Pacific, which is 01:00 UTC the next day, so other sources may show the previous day. Counts: Limitless TCG totals; regular+secret split where known. dataDate is when this file was last checked.
